name: Empyreal College of Cadence
desc: The Empyreal College of Cadence was a university in [Constellia](location:constellia). [Galpin Spellhardt, Musicologist Extraordinaire](entity:galpin_spellhardt_musicologist_extraordinaire) was a senior musicologist and faculty chair at the institution.
additional_info: -   The Empyrean is the highest heaven which was associated with fire or aether. It was inspired by Aristotle's interpretation of the cosmos.
